# ClaimHive
> AI command center and CRM for licensed United States public adjusting firms.

ClaimHive is a cloud-based practice management and document-automation platform built inside a working public adjusting firm. It is for licensed U.S. public adjusters, from solo practitioners to boutique firms, and their staff.

## What ClaimHive Is
- An AI command center and CRM for public adjusting firms.
- Built to manage the claim lifecycle: intake, evidence and policy review, scope and estimate organization, demand tracking, and settlement reconciliation.
- Chip drafts paperwork and follow-ups for a licensed adjuster to review.
- A read-only client portal for property owners represented by a licensed public adjuster.
- Customer claim files are not used to train public AI models.

## Who It Is For
- Licensed USA public adjusters and independent public adjusting firms.
- Adjuster support staff: estimators, document managers, file coordinators, and client concierges.
- Policyholders represented by a licensed PA, via a view-only portal.

## Pricing
- $80 per seat per month plus direct token usage (compute ClaimHive's AI does for the firm).
- Founding rate of $80/seat per month locked through June 30, 2027 for firms that join before January 31, 2027.
- Beta opens November 1, 2026. General availability January 1, 2027.
- Month-to-month billing. Firms can cancel and export their data.
- No per-claim surcharge and no cut of settlement fees.
- Policyholder / guest portal access is included.

## What ClaimHive Is NOT
- NOT a generic sales CRM, marketing funnel, or real-estate prospecting tool.
- NOT an estimating engine: it organizes, reconciles, and tracks Xactimate and Symbility estimates; it does not calculate line-item construction pricing.
- NOT a carrier or insurance-defense tool. It is built for policyholder advocates (public adjusters).
- NOT an unverified chatbot wrapper. Automated drafts and deadline calculations require licensed adjuster review.
